text:
Priya: Heads-up - postmortem actions keep drifting. Can we agree on a lightweight follow-up ritual so owners and dates are clear?
Maya: +1. We need something simple that fits into people's calendars.
Sam: Proposal: 3 checkpoints only - 48h triage note, 14-day remediation sync, 60-day recurrence check. Keeps things actionable.
Kevin: I like 60d instead of 90d for faster catchups. Also add a visibility rule: any remediation >14d shows up in the weekly digest.
Elena: Mechanic: owner must create a 30-min "PM: follow-up" calendar invite within 72h of closure and add eng-oncall + SRE.
Maya: Agree. Calendar invite should include a short agenda and link to remediation tickets.
Nate: I can wire IncidentBot to auto-create reminders if the owner forgets. Pete's script can be reused.
Priya: Can we standardize a one-page 14-day checklist? Make it copy/pasteable.
Maya: Draft template:
```
14-day remediation sync:
- PM incident id: <id>
- Owner: <name> (single POC)
- Open remediations: bullet list w/ ticket links
- Severity & SLA: P0/P1/P2 + due date
- Current status: on-track / blocked / deferred
- Blockers & mitigation steps
- Next actions: assign + due dates
- Escalate if missed twice -> notify team lead
```
Sam: SLA suggestion: P0 = 3 days, P1 = 14 days, P2 = 45 days. Owners can request extension with justification on the ticket.
Kevin: Add ticket tagging convention: incident-<id>-rem and rem-owner:<github>. Helps board/filtering.
Elena: And a top-of-doc tracker table so anyone opening the PM sees open remediations at a glance.
Priya: For IC rotation: monthly nominations, maintain a simple roster doc, and require a 15-min handoff note in the incident thread when rotating.
Maya: Also a 1-hr monthly IC sync to scan outstanding remediations across incidents. Keep it optional for contributors but mandatory for current ICs.
Nate: I'll set IncidentBot to post a weekly "open remediations >14d" digest to #eng-oncall every Monday.
IncidentBot: Scheduled: weekly digest for open remediations (>14d) posted to #eng-oncall.
Sam: On comms cadence: closure announcement (short), 48h triage summary (what we know), 14-day owner update (status), 60-day recurrence note. Keep each <4 lines.
Kevin: For ownership clarity: add a single POC field in the PM doc and a small "ownership checklist" the POC must complete (invite created, tickets updated, board row set).
Elena: Recurrence signals to check at 60d: increased frequency, matching root cause in last year, mitigations incomplete. If yes -> schedule a deeper review.
Priya: What about missed checks? If owner misses two consecutive 14-day syncs, auto-escalate to the team lead and flag on the digest.
Maya: Sounds reasonable. We'll pilot for 8 weeks and review metrics: % remediations closed within SLA, missed checks, escalations.
Nate: I'll add a small column to the board for "14-day checked" to simplify queries.
IncidentBot: Reminder: "2040156789 - 14-day follow-up due" assigned to Priya in 14 days.
Priya: I'll draft the templates, the IC roster doc, and a one-pager for the rotation runbook. Will ping folks for review tomorrow.
Sam: Thanks — this feels actionable. :thumbsup:
Kevin: If this sticks, we should bake the templates into the postmortem doc skeleton so owners don't forget.
Elena: Agreed. Less friction = adoption.
Maya: Okay team — next steps: Priya draft, Nate bot changes, Maya will add board columns. Review in 2 weeks. :calendar:
